text:
Faculty reviews - Summer 2025 
ECO372 - SME (Dr. Syed Mortuza Asif Ehsan)
Ehsan sir teaches really well and definitely knows his stuff. Econometrics is a heavy course and requires a lot of attention to be grasped properly. Sir delves deeply into the topics, but that also means you won’t get a good grade without proper self-study, since he covers A LOT of content. He takes three quizzes and counts the best two. The quizzes consist of T/F and short questions. The mids and the final have the same pattern but carry heavier weights. To perform well in the exams, it’s important to take extensive notes during his classes and solve the problem sets he provides. Even though he recommends practicing questions from the book, I personally don’t think it’s absolutely necessary; just understanding the concepts thoroughly should be enough. There’s also a fairly basic group project. He marks leniently and also curves based on class performance.
FIN440 - Sys (Mr. Syed Asif Hossain)
If you really want to learn corporate finance, Asif sir is a fantastic option. He teaches very well, but getting a good grade in his course will require some effort. He takes three quizzes (MCQ and T/F-based) and drops the worst one. The mids and the final include both mathematical and theoretical questions. The questions will be based on what he teaches in the class and what he highlights from the book. The only challenging thing would be the time management, as he gives A LOT of maths. There is also a demanding group project, so it’s better to start early to avoid immense last-minute pressure. Lastly, he is EXTREMELY GENEROUS when it comes to partial marking, and he curves as well. 
INB372 - FHZ (Ms. Farhana Habib Zinnia)
Zinnia ma'am is super nice. She's very easygoing and doesn’t burden students with any sort of unnecessary activities at all. Her teaching style is very clear, and she keeps the lectures short. There are three MCQ-based quizzes, and the best two are counted. The mid and the final consist of MCQs, T/F, and case-based questions. To do well in the exams, just go through the slides and understand the concepts properly; that would be more than enough. She took two case studies and an SLA case this semester. There is a very basic report and a presentation, too. Just make sure not to copy-paste directly from GPT, and you'll get good marks. Lastly, she curves based on the overall performance of the section. All in all, 100/100 experience! See less

Faculty Reviews:
Summer 2023
YKR (Mr Yasin Kabir)
ENV107.24 (ST 8:00am)
Chillest course ever with a very chilled person. This course was taught in a very practical way showing us examples and knowledge applied to the real world. Hence, a lot of my cousemates thought this was more environmental management than science. But overall I LOVED what I learnt in this course. Always write down what sir writes on the board and what he says. You do not need to memorise entire slides. Sir will give detailed suggestions before every quiz and mid, just follow those and you’re good to go for the written part, simply skim through slides and classnotes for the mcqs. He took 2 mids and 3 quizzes (though we only had a chance to sit of 2 because of the blockades towards the end of this semester). He also took an assignment and a group presentation, both very chilled, just follow the very simple instructions he gives. And there was a very interesting field trip to visit two public toilets within Dhaka city, in Gulshan and at Kamlapur Railway Station. He probably curves too. Very useful course taught by a person with work experience in the field. I believe this is a very useful GenEd course that introduced me to fields of jobs and knowledge I was previously unaware of. Absolutely amazing.
RaSn (Ms Raihana Sharmin)
PSY101.10 (MW 12:15pm)
Very cooperative instructor with very clear instructions. Just study her slides and what she teaches in class, you’ll be good to go. Expect very interactive classes. Miss loves a lively class. 1 mid, 3 quizzes, and an assignment, that’s it. Very straightforward course overall.
SK (Dr Shahansha Khan)
MAT120.18 (ST 12:15pm)
Very organised teacher who solves all problems on the whiteboard. Write down everything he writes on the board, try to solve all problems he gives in class. If you don’t get anything, just ask, he’s very helpful. He takes 1 mid, 2 assignments, and 3/4 quizzes. For the exams, go through classnotes, and also have a look at the suggested maths problems from the book. Most of his questions are from the lectures, but do expect 1/2 tricky questions from the book in the mid and final. He highly values full attention in class, and probably curves based on that as well.
I also did eco372 (GRG), eco301 (RfAh), and eco328 (JvHn). Leave a comment/dm if you want to know about them.
